name: Elephant sanctuary

seo.title: Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Walk with the elephants, feed them and join their mud bath. No riding. Three programmes up to a full day, hotel transfer included. From 1,800 THB.

draft.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta – No Riding
draft.h1: Ethical elephant sanctuary on Koh Lanta

lead: Walk with the elephants, feed them bananas and join them in the mud bath and the pool. No riding and no show.
promise: No riding, three programmes up to a full day

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: About 1 hr 30 min to a full day

options.label: Programme C, full day
options.note: Two people per session at most. Book it early.

steps.label: A
steps.text: About 1 hr 30 min to 2 hours. A walk with the elephants, feeding, the mud bath and the pool.

steps.label: B
steps.text: About 3 hours, 07:30 or 13:00. All of A, plus making herbal remedies and elephant-dung paper. Coffee and tea.

steps.label: C
steps.text: Full day from 07:30. All of B, plus a Thai set lunch, the Emerald Pool and the hot spring waterfall.

included: Programme C: lunch and the entrance fees

bring: Clothes that can get dirty and wet
beforeYouBook.pickup: Hotel transfer both ways. Sessions start at 07:30, 10:00 and 13:00.

faq.a: No. There is no riding and no show. You walk with the elephants, feed them and wash them.
About 1 hr 30 min to 2 hours for Programme A, about 3 hours for B and a full day for C, plus the transfer from your hotel.

faq.q: Is it suitable for small children?
faq.a: Yes. Ages 4 to 10 pay the child rate and under 4 go free. Children stay next to you the whole time.

legacyText.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
intro: The sanctuary is on Koh Lanta. There is no riding and no show. You spend the time next to the animals, feeding them bananas, walking with them and washing them.
Sessions start at 7:30, 10:00 and 13:00. Come in clothes that can get dirty and wet, with a towel and flip-flops.
legacyText.cardDescription: Feeding and walking with the elephants, no riding.
goodToKnow: Children from 4 to 10 pay a child rate. Under 4 go free.
Programme C takes two people per session only. Book it early.
You will get muddy. Bring a change of clothes.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. Children under 4 go free.
legacyText.caption: No riding
